name: prism
description: Provider-neutral agent runtime with pluggable providers, tools, and policies. Subprocess plugins inherit ambient host authority unless an isolation adapter is used.

scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @useprism/sdk && npm run build -w @useprism/runtime
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @useprism/provider-codex && npm run build -w @useprism/provider-ollama && npm run build -w @useprism/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:references && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:pnh:run: npm run typecheck:pnh && npm run check:pnh-graph && node packages/runtime/test/sandbox/harness/run-sandbox.mjs
scripts.test:pnh: npm run build:packages && npm run test:pnh:run
scripts.test:constitution:run: tsx --test pnh/tests/constitution-registry.test.ts pnh/tests/constitution-coverage.test.ts pnh/tests/constitution-proof-report.test.ts pnh/tests/constitution-generator.test.ts pnh/tests/constitution-gate.test.ts pnh/tests/public-claims.test.ts pnh/tests/protocol-bounds.test.ts
scripts.test:constitution: npm run build:packages && npm run test:constitution:run
scripts.test:host: npm run build:packages && npm run test:host:run
scripts.test:compat: npm run build:packages && npm run test:compat:run
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build:packages && npm run test:sdk:run
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build:packages && npm run test:runtime:run
scripts.test:provider-codex: npm run build:packages && npm run test:provider-codex:run
scripts.test:provider-ollama: npm run build:packages && npm run test:provider-ollama:run
scripts.test:cli: npm run build:packages && npm run test:cli:run
scripts.test:native:authoring: npm run native:verify -w @useprism/cli && npm run native:test -w @useprism/cli
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:references && npm run check:source-closure && npm run check:package-graph && npm run test:native:authoring && npm run test:pnh:run && npm run test:constitution:run && npm run test:host:run && npm run test:compat:run && npm run test:sdk:run && npm run test:runtime:run && npm run test:provider-codex:run && npm run test:provider-ollama:run && npm run test:cli:run && npm run check:public-claims
scripts.test:packed: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:references && npm run check:source-closure && npm run check:package-graph && node scripts/test-packed-install.mjs
